**Subjects:**  
- Primary subject: Male, mid-teens to early 20s, curly brown hair, wearing red hooded sweatshirt and light-colored shorts. Leaning over balcony railing, extending right arm downward holding green glass bottle (partially obscured label).  
- Secondary subject: Male, late teens to early 30s, short dark hair, white t-shirt with red collar trim, khaki cargo pants. Standing below on ground level, looking upward toward primary subject; left hand near waist, possibly holding small object or adjusting clothing.  
- Background group: Four individuals visible on upper balcony — two females (one blonde, one brunette), one male with beard, one partially obscured person. All leaning forward, observing interaction between primary and secondary subjects.

**Setting:**  
Urban residential exterior. Multi-story building with stucco facade, ornate wrought-iron balconies featuring scrollwork railings. Architectural details include recessed window frames, decorative cornice moldings, louvered vent panel on wall adjacent to lower doorway. Ground-level entrance has weathered teal-painted door frame.

**Lighting:**  
Natural daylight, diffuse overhead illumination. Shadows cast beneath balconies and along vertical surfaces indicate sun positioned high and slightly behind camera plane. No artificial lighting sources visible. Contrast moderate; highlights on skin and fabric suggest clear sky conditions.

**Composition:**  
Vertical orientation. Diagonal visual flow created by line of sight from upper balcony down to street level
